arena: classic_generic_2022 procedural_v2 11x9 two-player reply-search-256/8/64 self-play, sample every fourth round
candidate: Two-layer 128-unit ReLU candidate scorer on frozen routed-v6 spatial features and 17 aggregate features; 20 epochs of map- and override-balanced hard-choice pairwise logistic training
decision: Reject. No new external offline validation, full-game gate, rating or deployment was attempted. The fresh seed6300000 full-game window remains untouched.
interpretation: Changing only the linear head to a two-layer MLP sharply reduced weighted pairwise training loss, but barely improved training top-choice agreement and catastrophically worsened internal-holdout teacher-choice and first-action agreement. Many false overrides persisted. Head capacity alone is not the missing ingredient; further work must localize feature generalization, teacher-score target and imbalance rather than re-tune this failed hard-choice model on its holdout maps.
